selected_evidence.requirement: Configure node1 to boot with audit=1 persistently
selected_evidence.summary: Initial inspection showed the parameter absent; the boot entry was updated; post-reboot evidence shows `audit=1` in both `/proc/cmdline` and the persistent grubby entry.

Captured baseline boot ID a70d7f83-6867-4c91-851d-7a1228689bb3, acknowledged the scheduled reboot, observed the connection reset, and confirmed recovery under changed boot ID a1ec8df1-7fcf-4645-b4ba-aa70a339b519. The system reports `running` with zero failed units.

commands.command:
set -eu
printf 'node=%s\n' "$NODE_NAME"
printf 'boot_id='; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
printf 'os='; . /etc/os-release; printf '%s %s\n' "$NAME" "$VERSION_ID"
printf 'cmdline='; cat /proc/cmdline
printf 'audit_param='; if grep -qw 'audit=1' /proc/cmdline; then printf 'present\n'; else printf 'absent\n'; fi
printf 'bootloader_entries:\n'; sudo -n grubby --info=ALL | grep -E '^(index|kernel|args)=' || true
printf 'system_state='; systemctl is-system-running || true
commands.stdout:
node=node1
boot_id=a70d7f83-6867-4c91-851d-7a1228689bb3
os=CentOS Stream 10
cmdline=BOOT_IMAGE=(hd0,gpt3)/boot/vmlinuz-6.12.0-205.el10.x86_64 root=UUID=759facae-f5ba-43be-b717-b4fd6540aefc ro console=ttyS0,115200n8 no_timer_check crashkernel=2G-64G:256M,64G-:512M
audit_param=absent
bootloader_entries:
index=0
kernel="/boot/vmlinuz-6.12.0-205.el10.x86_64"
args="ro console=ttyS0,115200n8 no_timer_check crashkernel=2G-64G:256M,64G-:512M"
system_state=running

commands.command:
set -eu
sudo -n grubby --update-kernel=ALL --args='audit=1'
printf 'updated_entries:\n'
sudo -n grubby --info=ALL | grep -E '^(index|kernel|args)='
entry_count=$(sudo -n grubby --info=ALL | grep -c '^args=')
audit_count=$(sudo -n grubby --info=ALL | grep '^args=' | grep -cw '.*audit=1.*')
printf 'entry_count=%s audit_entry_count=%s\n' "$entry_count" "$audit_count"
[ "$entry_count" -eq "$audit_count" ]
commands.stdout:
updated_entries:
index=0
kernel="/boot/vmlinuz-6.12.0-205.el10.x86_64"
args="ro console=ttyS0,115200n8 no_timer_check crashkernel=2G-64G:256M,64G-:512M audit=1"
entry_count=1 audit_entry_count=1

commands.command:
set -eu
printf 'pre_restart_boot_id='; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
sudo -n systemd-run --unit=benchmark-reboot --on-active=2s /usr/bin/systemctl reboot
printf 'restart_acknowledged=scheduled\n'
commands.stdout:
pre_restart_boot_id=a70d7f83-6867-4c91-851d-7a1228689bb3
Running timer as unit: benchmark-reboot.timer
Will run service as unit: benchmark-reboot.service
restart_acknowledged=scheduled

commands.command: printf 'reachable=yes\n'; printf 'boot_id='; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id; printf 'system_state='; systemctl is-system-running || true

set -eu
old='a70d7f83-6867-4c91-851d-7a1228689bb3'
new=$(cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id)
printf 'old_boot_id=%s\nnew_boot_id=%s\n' "$old" "$new"
[ "$new" != "$old" ]
printf 'cmdline='; cat /proc/cmdline
grep -qw 'audit=1' /proc/cmdline
printf 'live_audit_parameter=present\n'
printf 'persistent_entries:\n'; sudo -n grubby --info=ALL | grep -E '^(index|kernel|args)='
sudo -n grubby --info=ALL | grep '^args=' | grep -qw '.*audit=1.*'
printf 'persistent_audit_parameter=present\n'
printf 'system_state='; systemctl is-system-running
printf 'failed_units='; systemctl --failed --no-legend --plain | wc -l
